reviews.t: Im tryna memorize voca that is used in usual routine.  I know there are lots of B.S applications in the market so I psychologically can't trust and dicide which one to use for building up my vocabulary abilities.  Seems like the reviews are filled up with many koreans who don't really know to give it a review. Any guys who are studying GRE in US can give me right feed back to choose that it is really worth to try studying using this app?

Memorizing new words seems to be hard. However I found this app and it helps me to improve my english. Now I have some suggestions here; the meaning of the words might be limited on this app.  If possible, the dictionary can be linked on the words. Also if i can add my own words that I want to remember, and play some games with that, it will much useful.
